admission.justification: Serving a changed manifest or asset would show bytes that no published revision attests.

applicability: Saved-first reopening, asset serving and regeneration of a ready frame.
conditions: A ready pointer names a revision whose manifest and assets are stored.
exclusions: A lineage with no ready revision, which reports its own reason.

evidence: A4-checks/probes.json: historical-manifest-integrity; focused F13 snapshot/corruption cases

statement: Saved-first opening, asset serving and regeneration must use one integrity-checked immutable revision snapshot and refuse corrupt or changed bytes rather than serving them as ready.
